title: Gateway first boot checklist
body: Power, link, then cloud. The LEDs report the first two only.

title: Choosing a CAN bus bitrate
body: Node count and cable length set the ceiling. Above 40 nodes stay at 250 kbit/s.

title: API rate limits
body: Limits are per key, per minute. Batch ingest is 300; reads are 600 to 1200.

title: Cursor pagination and key rotation
body: Cursors are signed with the issuing key and are invalidated when it is rotated.

title: Migrating off /v0/metrics
body: The v0 metrics endpoint is deprecated and returns 410 for all callers.
